name: SAGEBRUSH_Invoke
label: SAGEBRUSH Invocation
description: Triggers SAGEBRUSH agent when user says the keyword

nodes.name: Invoke SAGEBRUSH
nodes.script: var handler = new SAGEBRUSHConversationHandler(); var result = handler.handleInvocation(session.getUserId(), 'virtualagent'); vaVars.put('sagebrush_session_id', result.sessionId); output = result.greeting;
